Sets the longest time that one `PhysicsUpdate` simulates in `PhysicsMode` 1 (frame steps), default 1/15 second. A longer frame is simulated as if it had this length.
@param seconds At least 0.001.
@param world The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
